env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

go env GOEXPERIMENT
! stdout logosarena

logos env GOEXPERIMENT
stdout '^logosarena$'

logos run .
stdout '-X:logosarena$'

go run .
stdout '^go1\.27\.[0-9]+$'
! stdout '-X:'
